_mo_ta: BANG CHUNG GOC -- than PATCH that ma trang Wi-Fi General gui di, do TRUC TIEP tren thiet bi 192.168.1.1.
_cach_do: Ghi de window.fetch de CHAN moi request khac GET: bat lai than roi tra 200 rong tai cho, KHONG chuyen tiep toi thiet bi. Nho vay doc duoc than that ma Wi-Fi KHONG bi cau hinh lai, khong ai mat ket noi. Sau khi do: go chan, nap lai trang, doc lai /ssids va /easyMesh xac nhan thiet bi nguyen ven.
_vi_sao_phai_do: Doc ma goc thay mot cho RAT dang ngo va suyt ket luan nham la LOI FIRMWARE. Do that cho ket qua NGUOC LAI -- khong co loi nao. Chi tiet o muc _doc_ma_gay_hieu_nham.

quan_sat_tren_ma: O nhap render voi name = `networks.${s}` trong do s = L = chi so cua radio 5G = 1
Kiem tra hop le chay tren `networks.${A}` trong do A = (isNetworkSeparate ? s : 0) = 0
Ham dung than Be() o che do gop doc t[0] -- tuc networks[0]
_doc_ma_gay_hieu_nham.suy_luan_sai: Nguoi dung sua networks.1 nhung luu lai doc networks[0] -> doi ten se khong an gi. Neu tin suy luan nay thi da ghi nham vao ISSUES la 'loi cua hang' va dung sai trong gia lap.
_doc_ma_gay_hieu_nham.su_that_do_duoc: Than PATCH chua TEN MOI cho CA HAI ban ghi SSID. Khong co loi nao. Trang thai form cua react-hook-form khong tuong ung 1-1 voi chi so hien tren thuoc tinh name, nen khong the suy tu ma minified.
_doc_ma_gay_hieu_nham.bai_hoc: Voi ma da nen, doc de ra GIA THUYET; chi phep do moi ra KET LUAN.

phep_do.thao_tac: Doi o 'Wi-Fi Network Name' tu 'FPT Telecom-C151' thanh 'TEN-MOI-THU-NGHIEM' roi bam Save, sau do bam Continue tren hop thoai 'Before we continue...'
phep_do._thu_tu: TUAN TU: ssids truoc, easyMesh sau. Ma goc dung await lan luot, KHONG phai Promise.all nhu trang System Settings.

_ket_luan: Che do GOP: gui CA HAI ban ghi cua loai do (2.4G va 5G), gia tri Y HET NHAU, chi khac id.
Dung DUNG 6 khoa: id, enabled, name, securityMode, passphrase, broadcastEnabled. KHONG gui radio, type, status, securityModesSupported.
id la dia chi MAC cua tung SSID, khong phai dang cfg+so nhu portForwarding.
enabled LUON la true (hang so trong ma goc, khong lay tu form).
ssidTypesConfigurations chi chua DUNG MOT muc -- loai cua tab dang mo. Cac loai khac khong gui, va nho merge-theo-id nen khong bi mat.

_con_thieu: Chua do che do TACH (useSeparateNetwork = true) -- tab SmartHome dang o che do do. Suy tu ma goc: gui networks.map(...) tuc moi ban ghi lay gia tri RIENG cua no. Chua co bang chung truc tiep.
Chua do truong hop securityMode = WPA23T (che do gop, gia tri gia). Ma goc tach no ra: 2.4G -> WPA2-Personal, radio khac -> WPA3-Personal-Transition. Chua co bang chung truc tiep.
Chua do luc doi cong tac 'Use separate network' (quy tac them/cat hau to ten). Xem DAC_TA_DOC_TAY.md muc 6.
